card.name: Digits inside lab and time thresholds
card.fires_on: Individual digits (like 0, 8, 5, 1) inside numbers in dose-hold thresholds, lab cutoffs and infusion times, e.g. hemoglobin less than 8 g/dL or over 60 minutes. Also fires on 'the' after 'times' in lab limit multiples.

modes.label: Lab cutoff numbers
modes.description: A digit in a lab value that triggers holding or interrupting treatment.
modes.example: avoid initiation or interrupt OLUMIANT treatment in patients with hemoglobin less than <<8>> g/dL

modes.label: Minutes or percent values
modes.description: A digit in a duration or percentage, often the second digit of a two-digit number.
modes.example: Administer the diluted solution as an intravenous infusion over 6<<0>> minutes

card.writes: It seems to favor odd rare tokens and suppress words like 'always' and 'usually', so no clear output effect beyond number continuation.
card.plain: It lights up on the digits of numeric cutoffs, such as a hemoglobin limit or an infusion time in minutes.
